The '''poisonspike''' was a type of [[Polearm/Legends|polearm]]. It was looted by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] from the [[N-K Necrosis]] sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ROTW" />
